notes.usb_dma_range: OBSERVED in the live FDT of bootloader bluejay-16.3-13642543: reserved-memory abl@f8800000, no-map, 16 MiB (hardware/probe-log-2026-10-21-run1.txt). ABL's DWC3 event buffer (GEVNTADR, moves between boots: 0xF8B92000, 0xF8D12000) lies inside it; XNU takes its USB DMA page from there (xnu patch 0082, like shim/usbpool.c) and refuses if GEVNTADR is outside this range. Re-measure after a bootloader update.
notes.userdata_mib: OBSERVED on the phone: GPT entry userdata first=0x22F1E6 last=0x1DC03FA on LUN 0 (hardware/ufs-gpt-read-2026-10-21.txt) = 28906005 x 4 KiB = 112914.08 MiB (the XNU log prints 112914 MiB). tools/check-ios-root.py refuses an iOS root image bigger than this.
notes.dram_banks: MEASURED on the phone (hardware/probe-log-2026-10-21-run1.txt): /memory banks 0x80000000 (2 GiB, many no-map carve-outs), 0x880000000 and 0x900000000 (2 GiB each, contiguous, no reserved range inside). The high pair is merged here.
notes.xnu_ram: RAM handed to XNU: the whole hole-free high range. XNU maps [kernel .. physBase+memSize) cacheable, so it must contain no carve-out; base and size are multiples of 32 MiB (16K-granule L2 block).
notes.fb_base: Framebuffer set up by ABL, a8r8g8b8; no framebuffer node in the FDT.
notes.volume_keys: SUPERSEDED by key_pins (the old text put all three pins in 0x174E0000; docs/research/05-fact-check.md section 2 corrects it).
notes.key_pins: [xnu sweet_hid_key index (0 power, 1 vol+, 2 vol-), pin-controller base PA, bank pctl_offset, pin]. power = gpa10-1 in pinctrl_gpio_alive 0x174D0000, gpa10 pctl_offset 0xE0 (pinctrl-exynos-arm64.c:941-950, Linux v6.12); vol+ = gpa8-1 and vol- = gpa7-3 in pinctrl_far_alive 0x174E0000, gpa8 0x40 / gpa7 0x20 (pinctrl-exynos-arm64.c:953-958); pins and banks from gs101-pixel-common.dtsi:40-65 and :798-853 (Linux master), Google DS gs101-common.dtsi:46-68 (docs/research/05-fact-check.md section 2). Read from source; not yet observed on bluejay (docs/research/16-keys-gs101.md). Feeds the /sweet-keys ADT node (tools/mkadt.py, xnu patch 0087).
notes.key_active_low: all three GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW (gpio flags 0xf downstream), gs101-pixel-common.dtsi:48,55,62. Read from source.
notes.touch: STMicro FTM5 (chip ID 0x36 0x48) over SPI (spi_11 / USI11_USI_PERIC1 at 0x10D40000), USI mode reg 0x10C2100C, max 10 MHz; pins gpp23-0..2 (func 2), CS gpp23-3, IRQ gpa9-0 (XEINT_20), reset gpp26-0; rails S2MPG10 LDO25M/LDO26M. Structured keys touch_* feed the /sweet-touch ADT node (tools/mkadt.py, xnu patch 0088). read from source (docs/research/05-fact-check.md section 1, Google DS-bj gs101-bluejay-touch.dtsi:6-16, DS-gs gs101-common-touch.dtsi:8-100 and gs101-fts-touch.dtsi:11-39): chip id st,dchip_id <0x36 0x48>, st,max-coords <1079 2399>, spi-max-frequency 10 MHz, pins as listed, TS_SPI_SEL = gpp26-1 (low = AP). SPI function 2 for gpp23-0..2: gs101-pinctrl.dtsi:1024-1029. The CS pin gpp23-3 is a GPIO (function output).
